title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to author and run playbooks could add messages to a…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where a user with permission to author and run playbooks can add messages to the log of a different playbook run, potentially causing that run to fail. This includes runs outside the labels the user is authorized to access. The issue arises because the product does not verify that playbook API requests use the trusted runtime context for the current playbook run.
